The pivot table takes simple columnwise data as input, and groups the entries into a two-dimensional table that provides a multidimensional aggregation & summarization of the data. The difference between pivot tables and GroupBy can sometimes cause confusion; it helps me to think of pivot tables as essentially a multidimensional version of GroupBy aggregation. That is, you splitapply-combine, but both the split and the combine happen across not a onedimensional index, but across a two- dimensional grid.
